Maintainer.Profile: Templates for the self-hosted apps of helmerzNL: DiscVault (4K UHD, Blu-ray and DVD collection manager, installed through the DiscVault launcher), 3D Print Pricing (cost price calculator and inventory for a 3D-print business), MealieShopper (week menu from Mealie to your supermarket basket) and Doorbell Map (neighbourhood map for door-to-door events), each with a beta template.
